adv_derived_2022-11_2023-10.note: Derived: (Nov22*21 + Dec22*21 + JanOct23*209)/251 with ASSUMED trade-date counts; approximation.

open_interest_end_month.note: IMPLIED values (Dow futures OI subtotal minus YM); the listed MYM OI cells copy MNQ OI (copy error in CME table). No owned bars before 2025-04-01 (A0).
